Entries equal to +inf mark\n// points that are not candidates (already clustered, or already in this\n// cluster). off < S; off += maxBatch) {\n            const int batch = std::min(maxBatch, S - off);\n            growClustersKernel<<<batch, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_points, d_clustered, N, threshold,\n                                                      d_seeds + off, d_ws, d_card + off, nullptr);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cardinalities.data(), d_card, S * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n        // Pick the seed with the largest cluster;
